lessons.source: owner directive + universal source-interpretation-provenance and transformation-preservation-proof
lessons.trigger: The source contains human-approved private therapy state and verbatim text.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Persist exact source artifacts first, retain boundary manifests privately, and make later corrections append-only provenance-bearing updates.
lessons.failureCondition: A summary replaces exact source, a correction silently rewrites history, or a boundary cannot be accounted for.
lessons.repairAction: Stop semantic use and rebuild from the exact private source bytes.

lessons.trigger: The checkout and PR are public while source content is private.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Keep payloads, keys, tokens, private manifests, and private-derived hashes outside Git; publish only generic code, synthetic tests, and explicitly authorized stable IDs in the canonical handoff.
lessons.failureCondition: A tracked file, PR field, CI log, or public receipt contains private content or a private-derived hash.
lessons.repairAction: Block push, remove the material from the candidate history, and rerun the all-history publication audit.

lessons.trigger: Local import, local MCP, remote connection, and fresh-chat execution are distinct boundaries.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Report each layer separately and require an actual newly created chat tool call for remote continuity.
lessons.failureCondition: A local green result is reported as ChatGPT availability.
lessons.repairAction: Keep the remote layer blocked and name the exact missing action.

lessons.trigger: The private state and import sequence were authored and approved in chat.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Codex mechanically materializes and verifies the supplied state; it does not invent therapy semantics or audit before fresh retrieval.
lessons.failureCondition: Codex adds unsupported case interpretation or performs the therapy audit before the retrieval gate.
lessons.repairAction: Stop and return the exact execution evidence to the reasoning chat.

lessons.trigger: A continuation gate decides whether exact recent therapy context is complete.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Require the exact contiguous transcript from the current episode's declared semantic start through the latest supplied turn; allow a pending candidate to answer a user-tail turn and do not impose a fixed exchange count.
lessons.failureCondition: A fixed count blocks an otherwise complete active episode, or an absent/truncated/reordered episode passes.
lessons.repairAction: Rebuild the window from the declared episode boundary and fail closed on any semantic completeness defect.

lessons.source: owner correction 2026-09-10 + official OpenAI MCP authentication and ChatGPT connection guidance
lessons.trigger: Hosted OAuth, MCP registration, or fresh-chat status is reported.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Verify issuer, audience, expiration, scope, case ACL and key access; then require a brand-new ChatGPT conversation to call load_handoff using only the stable handoff ID before FRESH_SESSION_GREEN.
lessons.failureCondition: Code, a local MCP, a reachable endpoint, OAuth discovery, registration, or tool visibility is reported as the new-chat result.
lessons.repairAction: Keep the handoff at READY_FOR_FRESH_SESSION_TEST and name the exact unverified boundary.
